source.snippet: I've been trying to enroll for Apple Developer for over a month and nothing works. The Apple Developer app won't accept my Canadian passport for identity verification. The enrollment is for a Delaware LLC, so my Apple account region is set to US. I can't switch the account region to Canada either, because I haven't lived there in years and don't have a Canadian bank card. If I enroll through the website, the enrollment gets approved, I accept the term and, when it...

problem_statement: Developers and small companies cannot reliably complete Apple Developer Program enrollment due to identity verification failures with non-US passports and region mismatches for international founders with US LLCs, blocking them from shipping iOS/macOS apps.
target_segment: Independent developers and small startup founders with US LLCs who live outside the US and are trying to enroll in the Apple Developer Program.
notes: 20 points and active comments suggest real pain. Buyers are paying developers (Apple Developer Program costs $99/yr) blocked from their primary distribution channel. Multiple users confirming same issue in thread. Willingness to pay for a concierge/guided enrollment service is implicit — every day blocked is lost revenue.
